account.title: Customer area
account.toastAuthRequired: Please log in to access your customer area.

export.title: Download my data
export.description: Get a structured copy of all the personal data we hold about you (profile, addresses, orders, subscriptions, consents) in machine-readable JSON, as provided by GDPR Articles 15 and 20.
export.error: Could not generate the export. Please try again.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.description: Permanently erase your account (GDPR Article 17). If you have past orders, accounting law (French Code de commerce, 10 years) requires us to keep the invoices: your account is then irreversibly anonymized instead of deleted, and access is revoked. Otherwise it is fully deleted.
delete.note: This action is irreversible and logs you out immediately.
delete.confirm: This will permanently erase or anonymize your account and log you out. This cannot be undone. Continue?
delete.success: Your account has been erased. You have been logged out.
delete.error: Could not delete your account. Please try again or contact support.

subscriptions.title: My subscriptions
subscriptions.subtitle: Review your active services and next billing dates.
subscriptions.empty: You have no active subscriptions at the moment.

modal.title: Disable automatic renewal
modal.message: This action stops automatic renewal for this subscription. You can enable it again later from this screen.

pastDue.title: Payment overdue
pastDue.text: The last renewal of this subscription failed. Update your payment method to avoid service interruption.
pastDue.portalError: Could not open the payment portal. Please try again.

history.title: Order history
history.subtitle: Find your order and invoice details.

invoices.title: My invoices
invoices.subtitle: Your invoices are generated and retained by our payment provider Stripe.

profile.title: Personal information
profile.subtitle: Manage your account details. Email changes require email verification.
profile.emailHint: A confirmation email will be sent to the new address.
profile.emailChangeSent: A confirmation email has been sent to your new address.
profile.emailChangeError: Unable to send the confirmation email.
profile.emailConfirmed: Your email address has been successfully updated.
profile.emailConfirmError: The confirmation link is invalid or has expired.
profile.passwordError: Incorrect current password or server error.

payment.title: My payment methods
payment.subtitle: The cards saved and used for your subscriptions.
payment.emptyDelegated: No card saved yet. You will be able to add one during your next purchase, or directly from the Stripe portal.

toast.error: An error occurred. Please try again.

portal.title: Manage my payment methods and invoices
portal.description: All operations on your cards and invoices are handled through our payment provider Stripe's secure portal. You will return here automatically when finished.
portal.error: Could not open Stripe portal. Please try again.
